key_impacts: Estimated US$80bn in damage and reconstruction costs
New York’s main water treatment system failed
Power stations shut down; backup generators inoperable due to fuel shortages
evidence_snippets: Hurricane Sandy, the most destructive hurricane of 2012, led to an estimated US$80bn bill.
New York’s main water treatment system failed because power stations were shut down.
Backup generators were inoperable due to lack of fuel supply.

key_impacts: About 40% reduction in the Russian grain harvest
Government imposed grain export bans to control domestic prices
Contributed to global grain price spikes
evidence_snippets: The European heat-wave of 2010 resulted in a 40% reduction in the Russian grain harvest.
The Russian government imposed export bans to control domestic food prices.
Combined with other shortfalls, this contributed to a doubling of grain prices globally.
